title: How to FIX your buggy Meta Ads Manager
description: How to FIX your buggy Meta Ads Manager
transcript: An underrated easy fix for a lot of meta ad campaigns is to just recreate it. Ads Manager is full of bugs and it's very common for something to go wrong within your ad campaign for it to not deliver properly or stop delivering at all. For number of errors to pop up that you don't really understand what's going on and how to fix them. Instead of trying to tweak it and change things and to get it to work. Sometimes better just to go you know what? I'm going to recreate this from scratch. Often that gets it to work, gets it to start delivering and delivering properly.
